overview: Studying Mechanical Engineering - UG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can Indian students study mechanical engineering in Finland after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply to English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for mechanical engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees range from approximately €10,000 to €12,000 (around ₹10.86 lakh to ₹13.03 lakh). LUT University offers €3,000 annual scholarships for the 2nd and 3rd years of its programme.

faq.question: Is IELTS compulsory for studying mechanical engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. While IELTS (minimum 6.0–6.5) is standard, universities also accept TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, SAT scores, or alternative university entrance assessments.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help me apply?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide assists with university shortlisting, eligibility evaluation, document verification, SOP reviews, Studyinfo.fi portal application, scholarship applications, and Finnish student residence permit guidance.
